- `content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx` (its title says "one app, many"): "More audiences therefore never mean more apps: they are navigation groups inside that one app", and later "one app per package". The amended ADR-0019 D3 (`958734cbac`) says a suite MAY surface more than one app, each defined by a different package of the suite. That page is a published docs surface, not `docs/adr/**`: it lands as an ordinary docs PR, not Tier H.
